entities.summary: Aldo Brovarone was an Italian automobile designer and the chief stylist with Carrozzeria Pininfarina (1974–1988) – widely known for a prominent range of work including the Dino 206 GT, Lancia Gamma Coupé and the Peugeot 504 (sedan).
